subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix for this issue be a narrow Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute repair, a shared inbound non-direct session fallback, or deferred until live Telegram restart proof is captured?
rationale: Current source supports a real remaining gap, but the narrow Telegram call-site repair and the shared fallback have different channel compatibility and ownership risk that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Prove and fix plain Telegram groups
options.body: Run live plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the repro points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Make the shared non-direct fallback the canonical fix after channel compatibility review and proof across affected channel plugins.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open as needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main Telegram restart evidence.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix plain Telegram groups
recommendation.body: Run live plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the repro points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on the shared inbound session recorder and route persistence boundary that steipete introduced and recently touched.
